EarlierRetentionCheck.OriginalCheckOutcome: Failed before own-window restoration was added to the test.
EarlierRetentionCheck.Explanation: The actual window was minimized, so the product intentionally did not render newer samples. The old UI timestamp had not crossed the fixture last-seen timestamp plus sixty seconds. A fresh complete system snapshot already showed zero fixture endpoints. The corrected test restores its own window once and waits at most ten seconds for a complete post-retention UI sample before asserting deletion.

PreMinwidthEvidence.EarlierUninstrumentedRetentionFailure: One previous fixed sixty-five-second check also failed without enough state diagnostics; its raw report remains preserved. It is not claimed as a separately diagnosed production defect.
PreMinwidthEvidence.ScreenshotMethod: Direct rendering of the actual WPF content root at 96 dpi in logical coordinates. The transparent root temporarily uses the same actual Window.Background brush while rendered, then is restored. These are content snapshots, not physical desktop screenshots.
PreMinwidthEvidence.Limitations: Actual control events, bindings, clipboard contents, process entry point, collector and executable icons are exercised. External mouse/keyboard input, Ctrl+F physical keyboard behavior, DPI transitions and multiple monitors are not verified. Search keyboard focus is an observation, not a passing input test.
